div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p:
State at the time of evaluation
The MAX30102 was not responding and
the DS18B20 probe was disconnected,
so the heart rate, SpO2 and temperature
displayed by the firmware were simulated.
The input pin freed by the probe carried
the SOS button.
The 3.5-inch TFT was parked, the LED
indicators were removed, and the microSD
card was not part of the delivered unit —
readings are logged in the cloud.
The device is audible and status-word only:
the word, the buzzer and the SMS carry
the alert.
